scenes.name: Acoustic Strumming & Distant Bell
scenes.subtitle: Carved wooden desks & morning sunlight • The corridor chatter fades

scenes.name: Measuring the Sky & 75% Attendance
scenes.subtitle: Beyond the blackboard • Carving our path upon quiet pages

lines.text: Aakhri bench pe baith ke humne, aasmaan ko naapa hai,
Attendance ki thodi chinta thi, par yaari poori pakki thi,
Bina baat ke hasne ki woh, aadat kitni achhi thi!

scenes.name: One Chai Cup & Stolen Sips
scenes.subtitle: Four friends, one cup of tea • Unfiltered laughter at the canteen

lines.text: Haan ek hi cup se chaar doston ko, ghoont churaate dekha hai,
Aakhri bench pe baith ke humne, aasmaan ko naapa hai.

scenes.name: Chalk Dust & Morning Sunbeam
scenes.subtitle: Golden dust motes dancing across green chalkboards • The bell chimes

scenes.name: Front Bench Toppers & Secret Tiffin
scenes.subtitle: Formulas on the board • Secretly sharing lunch under the desk

lines.text: Front bench pe baith ke topper saare, answer yaad kiya karte,
Hum aakhri bench ke baaghi the, bas khwaab tarasha karte the.
Blackboard ki lambi equations se, man thoda ghabraata tha,
Par desk ke neeche chupke se, ik tiffin khul jaata tha!

scenes.name: Xerox Copies & The Proxy Call
scenes.subtitle: "Kal padhenge" nightouts • The thrill of shouting proxy for a late friend

lines.text: "Kal padhenge" keh kar humne, saari raatein baanti hain,
Subah-subah phir exam se pehle, xerox copy maangi hain.
Woh roll number par doosre ki, aawaaz lagana yaad raha,
Kaghaz ki kashti jaisa tha man, leharon pe behna yaad raha!

scenes.name: Carved Desks & The Infinite Sky
scenes.subtitle: Carving our names with compass needles • Standing tall together

lines.text: Aakhri bench pe baith ke humne, aasmaan ko naapa hai,
Kitabon ke soye panno par, apna safar tarasha hai.
Haan ek hi cup se chaar doston ko, ghoont churaate dekha hai,
Aakhri bench pe baith ke humne, aasmaan ko naapa hai.

scenes.name: Canteen Ledger & Tapri Resonance
scenes.subtitle: Crumbled samosas on paper plates • The world measured in shared laughter

scenes.name: Canteen Diary & Calls to Maa
scenes.subtitle: Lying on the phone that we ate • Silent tears wiped in hostel corners

lines.text: Canteen ki udhaar diary mein, apna bhi ek panna tha,
Par dil ke andar sach poocho toh, kuch bada banne ka sapna tha.
Maa ke phone pe jhooth kaha tha, "Haan maine khaana khaya hai,"
Aankh bacha ke room ke kone mein, aansu chupke bahaya hai.

scenes.name: 3 AM Rooftops & The Unbowed Flame
scenes.subtitle: Terrace chords at 3 AM • Marksheets will never constrain our fate

lines.text: Koi naukri ki fikar mein gum tha, koi shayar banna chahta tha,
Par raat ke teen baje chhat par, sab ek hi dhoon gungunata tha!
Marksheet ke un chote tukdon par, taqdeer nahi ruk sakti hai,
Yeh aakhri bench ki aag kabhi, toofaan se nahi jhuk sakti hai!

scenes.name: Final Semester & Paper Airplanes
scenes.subtitle: Carving names with penknives • Launching paper airplanes toward the clouds

lines.text: Yeh aakhri semester aate hi, ab dil thoda sa darta hai,
Kal tak jo class thi bore lagti, ab chhootne se man marta hai.
Woh bench jis par humne chaku se, sabke naam tarashe the,
Woh panno ke airplane bana kar, hawa mein jo tarashe the!

scenes.name: Memories Echoing Across Centuries
scenes.subtitle: The world moves on • But backbench laughter echoes through time

lines.text: Duniya toh kahegi aage badho, par yaadein yahin pe thehrengi,
Har aakhri bench ke yaaron ki, baatein sadiyon tak goonjengi...
Haan sadiyon tak goonjengi!
Aakhri bench pe baith ke humne, aasmaan ko naapa tha!

scenes.name: The Final Bell & The Infinite Journey
scenes.subtitle: The quiet hallway echoes • But the journey is just beginning

lines.text: Woh ghanti aakhri baj chali hai, par safar abhi toh baaqi hai...
Aakhri bench pe baith ke humne... aasmaan ko naapa tha...
